'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Gaziantep hospital fire]]
**A fire inside an [[intensive care unit]] for [[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey|COVID-19]] patients at a [[private hospital]] in [[Gaziantep]], [[Turkey]], kills nine people. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-turkey-fire/fire-in-hospital-kills-8-people-in-southeast-turkey-governor-idUKKBN28T0AS?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] announces the introduction of "Tier 4" restrictions in [[London]] and [[South East England]] beginning at midnight. Households in those areas are to be banned from mixing over the festive season, while in the rest of the country, mixing of households will only be allowed on [[Christmas Day]]. [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-12-19/covid-19-boris-johnson-expected-to-announce-tier-4-for-london-and-south-east-as-coronavirus-cases-soar (ITV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****[[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]] announces a travel ban to the rest of the [[United Kingdom]] and imposes the toughest level of restrictions across [[Scotland]] for three weeks beginning on [[Boxing Day]]. In addition, household mixing will now only be allowed on Christmas Day. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/scotland-travel-ban-lockdown-nicola-sturgeon-b1776619.html (''The Independent'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wales]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[First Minister of Wales|First Minister]] [[Mark Drakeford]] announces that after urgent talks with ministers over the discovery of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2, the planned [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] will now begin at midnight instead of on December 28. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-55379237 (BBC News)]
****The [[United Kingdom]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/uk-covid-death-toll-latest-figures-tier-4-b390338.html (''The Evening Standard'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Switzerland]]
*****[[Swissmedic]] approves the authorization of the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]] for use in [[Switzerland]]. [https://www.swissmedic.ch/swissmedic/en/home/news/coronavirus-covid-19/covid-19-impfstoff_erstzulassung.html (Swissmedic)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] surpasses 6,000 total deaths of COVID-19. [https://www.euroweeklynews.com/2020/12/19/portugal-exceeds-6000-deaths-since-start-of-the-pandemic/amp/ (Euro Weekly News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] surpasses 50,000 total deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/12/19/Coronavirus-Coronavirus-Russia-s-COVID-19-deaths-surpass-50-000 (Al-Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://azeritimes.com/2020/12/20/turkeys-covid-19-cases-hit-2-million-mark-as-outbreak-slows-down/ (''The Azeri Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in China]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
*****[[China]] is expected to begin administering [[vaccine]]s to healthcare, transport, and [[border control]] workers. [https://apnews.com/article/seniors-turkey-beijing-coronavirus-pandemic-china-c3ba39358649153b66380e4858f814c5 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
*****[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] became the first person in [[Israel]] to receive [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|the vaccine]] made by [[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] and getting the shot on live television. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/netanyahu-is-1st-israeli-to-get-covid-vaccine-start-of-return-to-normal-life/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Jakarta]] reports a record of 1,899 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours. [https://voi.id/en/berita/23674/new-cases-of-covid-19-in-jakarta-1899-this-is-the-explanation-of-the-dki-jakarta-health-office (VOI)]
****[[Bali]] requires anyone entering and leaving the province to have a negative [[Polymerase chain reaction|PCR]] swab test for air travel, and a negative rapid antigen test for land and sea travel. However, children aged 12 years and under are exempted from these requirements. [https://www.thebalitimes.com/headlines/the-rules-for-entering-bali-have-changed-pcr-swab-tests-are-valid-for-a-maximum-of-7-days-prior-to-departure/ (''The Bali Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports 548 new cases, the biggest one-day increase in cases since the beginning of the [[pandemic]], primarily due to an outbreak linked to the country's largest seafood market in [[Samut Sakhon Province]] as well as increased testing of [[migrant worker]]s. [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3114663/thailand-sees-record-548-new-virus-cases-tied-seafood (''South China Morning Post'')]
****Due to the outbreak in a seafood market, [[Samut Sakhon Province]] enters a [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] with a curfew from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time which will remain in effect until January 3. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2038107/samut-sakhon-goes-into-lockdown (''The Bangkok Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] surpasses ten million total cases of [[COVID-19]], becoming the second country after the [[United States]] to reach that number. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/india-cases-cross-1-crore-323-days-after-1st-last-1m-2nd-slowest/articleshow/79806546.cms (''The Times of India'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/indias-health-ministry-coronavirus-cases-crossed-10-million-74814985 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***The total number of cases in [[Africa]] exceeds 2.5 million. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-africa-cases-idUSL8N2IZ0FS (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***The [[Northern Beaches Council]] local government area of [[Sydney]] goes into a partial lockdown until Wednesday. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-12-19/nsw-covid-rules-in-response-to-northern-beaches-cluster/12998408 (ABC Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia]]
***[[Colombia]] reports a record 13,990 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total to  1,496,062. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2020-12/20/c_139604500.htm (Xinhua)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[Canada]] surpasses 500,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2020/12/19/covid-19-vaccinations-now-underway-in-all-provinces-as-new-brunswick-gives-1st-shot.html (''Toronto Star'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 Central African general election]]
**The leaders of three of the main armed groups of the [[Central African Republic]] announce a coalition for next week's general election, a move that could further increase tensions ahead of the election, where the opposition fears massive voter fraud. The armed groups named themselves the Coalition of Patriots for Change and invited other armed groups to join, while urging them to protect the integrity of civilians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/19/armed-rebel-groups-in-c-africa-form-coalition (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2020 United States federal government data breach]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] speaks for the first time about the breach, saying it is "well in control". He also suggests China is to blame, contradicting earlier U.S. government claims that put forward Russia as a suspect. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/trump-downplays-russia-hack-first-comments-massive-breach-implicates-china-n1251813 (NBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**The 2020 [[Sydney to Hobart Yacht Race]] is cancelled for the first time in the race's 76-year history after the [[Tasmanian Government]] imposed a 14-day [[quarantine]] requirement on all travellers from [[Greater Sydney]] due to the COVID-19 outbreak in the [[Northern Beaches]]. [https://www.smh.com.au/sport/sailing/sydney-to-hobart-in-huge-doubt-as-tasmania-imposes-nsw-restrictions-20201219-p56oy8.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
